decisions: Only stock pages with reviewed editorial coverage remain indexable and in the sitemap.
Legacy automated daily briefs remain accessible but are noindex and excluded from public listings and the sitemap.
The www host permanently redirects to the apex host in application configuration.
Dynamic OG images return an X-Robots-Tag noindex header.
Previously failed article URLs returned HTTP 200 during the 2026-07-28 audit.
Traffic totals are not treated as an audience baseline because 81% of active users were attributed to Singapore and 99% of channel-attributed new users were Direct.
Successful newsletter submissions now emit GA4 generate_lead events because six stored subscribers were not represented in the zero-lead analytics report.
